# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 and docs** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.154.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships XML documentation with the managed packages. The release refreshes the bundled renderer, improves generated binding maintenance, and updates HarfBuzzSharp from the same native source used in the package.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed** — The misspelled `CCC133` member is now `CCC132`, matching the corrected upstream HarfBuzz name. Update source references to the new member name before upgrading.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is removed** — The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed. Code that used `GlyphFlags.Defined` should combine the concrete glyph flags it needs instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Moves the bundled renderer to m154 and incorporates upstream Chrome fixes for buffer uploads and stale Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))

## API Surface

- **XML API documentation now ships with packages** — Managed package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation, including Markdown-authored view remarks, alongside the API assemblies. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
- **HarfBuzz bindings follow the bundled source** — HarfBuzzSharp bindings are generated from the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping ordinary existing APIs synchronized with the native library. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Bug Fixes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The m154 release disables RAW and DNG image decoding to avoid relying on unsupported decoding paths. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp now generates its bindings from the bundled HarfBuzz source, keeping the managed declarations aligned with version 14.2.1 while correcting its enum surface.
